product.industry: Independent film, visual effects and production studio
product.audience: Creative directors, producers and commissioners preparing a film, campaign or title sequence
product.decision: Whether the studio has the craft, production model and point of view to shape their brief
product.conversion: Assemble and submit a concise production treatment request

signature.moment: A live 144-frame monitor resolves as visitors scrub time and switch architecture, atmosphere, signal-light and grade layers before assembling a production treatment

systems.hero: A compact monitor wall: title and live production slate sit beside one hero frame, a vertical shot list and timecode rather than a centered cinematic poster
systems.navigation: A narrow production header with direct reel, treatment, craft and contact cues; no fullscreen navigation overlay
systems.contentDensity: Operational and editorial: dense metadata beside quiet wide frames, changing scale at every stage
systems.geometry: Film-frame rectangles, crop marks, timeline rails, ruled ledgers and asymmetric split screens
systems.motion: Frame-accurate canvas redraws and short state readout transitions tied to explicit scrubbing and layer switches; no decorative infinite motion
systems.coreInteraction: Visitors scrub a live composite and switch its image stack, select frames on a reel timeline, then assemble a visible treatment summary they can carry into an enquiry

structuralDifferences: The mobile first fold leads with a live monitor and shot metadata before the studio statement
The desktop compositing suite becomes a tall director monitor with a two-column layer wallet and thumb-reachable frame steps
The horizontal desktop reel becomes a numbered shot-list with previous and next controls
Treatment decisions appear one prompt at a time and the completed brief becomes a compact call sheet
VFX breakdown uses an explicit before-after switch instead of desktop split comparison

artDirection.typography: System grotesk for confident titles, monospaced production metadata and one restrained serif voice for director notes; no external fonts
artDirection.material: Near-black grading suite, warm projector white, oxide red marks and acid-green playback signals with subtle film grain
artDirection.imageLogic: Three original local film stills form one nocturnal sci-fi sequence; CSS creates monitor glass, masks, safe-area guides and timeline notation
artDirection.microcopy: Rushes, cut, plate, shot, grade, treatment, call sheet, delivery and production-window language
artDirection.dataHonesty: Project credits, dates and production figures are clearly labelled as sample studio content; no false awards or client claims

interactions.name: Live compositing timeline
interactions.input: Scrub the frame range, step twelve frames or switch image layers
interactions.stateChange: Canvas composite, frame counter, layer status and finishing phase update
interactions.visibleResult: A production-style composite resolves directly in the monitor without autoplay or decorative looping

interactions.name: Reel timeline
interactions.input: Select a scene frame or use previous and next shot controls
interactions.stateChange: Active frame, timecode, project label and monitor image update
interactions.visibleResult: A newly composed monitor view with scene-specific metadata and director note

interactions.name: Treatment assembler
interactions.input: Choose project format, emotional temperature and production need
interactions.stateChange: Prompt progress and treatment fields update
interactions.visibleResult: A completed call-sheet summary and recommended starting conversation

interactions.name: VFX plate comparison
interactions.input: Switch between photographed plate and final composite
interactions.stateChange: Viewport grade, overlay treatment and annotations change
interactions.visibleResult: The practical contribution of compositing becomes legible without drag-only interaction

assetStrategy: Three coordinated original local stills tell one nocturnal signal-chase story. Each is a distinct shot and crop role; no asset is reused as decoration elsewhere.

assets.role: Hero establishing frame of a lone figure entering the signal environment
assets.focalCrop: Wide 16:10 with figure on right third and open monitor space left
assets.mobileSafeArea: Central-right figure remains visible in a shallow 4:3 monitor crop

assets.role: Reel mid-shot and VFX plate subject showing the physical light installation
assets.focalCrop: Wide symmetrical corridor with luminous practical sculpture centered
assets.mobileSafeArea: Central sculpture remains intact in square crop

assets.role: Reel finale frame showing kinetic movement through wet architecture
assets.focalCrop: Low-angle wide frame with runner in left middle ground
assets.mobileSafeArea: Runner and strongest red reflection stay within middle 70 percent

adjacentTemplates.why: This is a production workspace and selectable edit; it has no pinned portrait reveal, persistent music player, tour grid or merchandise journey.
The casework is presented as rushes and production metadata, while conversion assembles a treatment rather than opening a generic agency booking drawer.
No expanding gallery image, ticket flow, exhibition grid or access panel; the defining action is editorial sequence selection.
The page uses a monitor and film timeline rather than an orbital sticky hero, thesis selector, company ledger and founder drawer.
The mobile director monitor and desktop cutting rail differ from the clinical passport, care-file layout and pathway comparison system.

avoid: Oversized uppercase plus italic-serif house formula
